messages.subject: F2 from outbred lines
parts:
Hi, can R/QTL be used for an F2 population derived from a cross between
two outbred lines? Thanks Peter

messages.author: ab8dbe3bec292afe
messages.subject: Re: F2 from outbred lines
parts:
It may not be possible. R/qtl can deal with a phase-known 4-way cross,
in which there are just two F1 parents and lots of progeny, but can't
deal with a general F2 population from outbred lines.

karl
